about_short_description.short_description: RunLocal helps engineering teams ship better on-device AI, faster and without the hassle.

product.name: Model Conversion Service
product.description: A service that converts AI models into on-device formats like CoreML and ONNX, addressing performance issues across various devices.

product.name: Device Testing Infrastructure
product.description: A testing platform that provides access to over 100 real devices across iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows for evaluating AI model performance.

product.name: Evaluation Tooling for Deployment Decisions
product.description: Tools that help assess AI model quality and performance to inform development and deployment strategies for on-device AI.

product.name: White-Glove Support Service
product.description: A support service that assists with debugging model conversion and performance issues throughout the on-device AI development lifecycle.
